name: snapforge
description: Connect Codex to a scoped SnapForge instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped SnapForge tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to SnapForge through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so SnapForge Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SnapForge only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
